# ShubhMart Copilot Instructions

Read `AGENTS.md`, `MEMORY.md`, and `RULES.md` before making changes. Follow the repository's security-first, audit-first workflow.

Do not change production databases, SQL/schema/security policies, payment settings, deployed functions, production hosting, PR merge state, paid services, or external systems without explicit approval. Preserve existing features. Use synthetic test data and protect secrets. Run appropriate checks and report evidence, limitations, and PASS / FAIL / BLOCKED / MISSING / UNVERIFIED status. Do not claim runtime security based only on source review or a passing build.
